messages:
marco: Heads-up — trying to unpin runtime 2.15 for the eu-canary batch. Deploybot showed a sticky pin yesterday, need a quick sanity check before we lift it.
anya: What was the root reason we pinned it? I remember a quant longseq regression on llama3q in eu-west.
marco: Right — long sequences hitting a kernel path that OOMed on 48GB configs. We mitigated with pin to 2.14 until a kernel patch landed. Patch merged in runtime yesterday.
deploybot: @channel deploybot: pinlist status changed for runtime-2.14 -> UNPIN_REQUESTED by marco at 1712229999. Affected routes: eu-west-canary (5 pools), eu-west-hosted (2 pools).
tess: CI smoke passed for the patched kernel on our staging qa (small-batch longseq bench). Still seeing a ~2% perf variance on 2.15 though — expected due to new kernel ordering.
sre-oncall: Can we run a quick canary on a non-prod tenant with 90s tail latency SLIs? If tail spikes, we should abort unpin.
anya: I can seed a reroute traffic test to eu-canary-2 (10% of canary) for the next 30m. Marco, would you like me to include a fallback to 2.14?
marco: Yes please. Start at 10% for 30m, fallback route to 2.14 on any error rate >1% or p99 > 450ms. If green, escalate to 50% then full.
deploybot: @marco requested canary ramp: eu-canary-2 -> 10% for 30m, fallback to runtime-2.14. (ID: cb-1712230001)
sre-oncall: I'll watch telemetry and set an alert. If p99 crosses 450ms, I'll flip the rollback flag.
tess: quick note for release notes: add compatibility note about kernel reorder impacting perf in longseq workloads and recommended config (batching/window size).
anya: Starting traffic now. Logs: ```curl -X POST https://deploy/api/reroute -d '{"route":"eu-canary-2","percent":10,"model_group":"llama3q"}'```
marco: thanks. Monitoring for 30m. If stable, I'll +1 the unpin and ask Deploybot to clear the pinlist.
deploybot: canary cb-1712230001 ramping -> 10% active.
sre-oncall: 10m in: no errors, p99 ~410ms, host mem stable. No KV cache thrash.
tess: 20m in: perf steady. variance still ~1.8% vs 2.14 on longseqs but within tolerance.
anya: 30m complete: metrics look good. Promoting to 50% now.
deploybot: canary cb-1712230001 updated -> 50% active.
sre-oncall: 10m after 50%: p99 ~420ms, error rate 0.02% — holding.
marco: OK let's proceed to full unpinning. Deploybot, remove runtime-2.14 from pinlist for eu-west. Leave a note in release notes about the rollback criteria and the kernel patch hash (git:abc1234).
deploybot: UNPIN_APPROVED by marco. Action: remove pin for runtime-2.14 on eu-west. ETA 90s.
sre-oncall: post-unpin watch: I'll keep a 2h pager window. If anything abnormal, I'll signal rollback.
tess: added release note snippet: "Runtime 2.15 unpin for eu-west: includes kernel reorder patch (git:abc1234). Monitor longseq p99; fallback to 2.14 if p99 > 450ms or error rate >1%."
marco: perfect. Closing thread unless someone sees an issue. :thumbsup:
